name: Longview Philanthropy
summary: An advisory for major donors on reducing catastrophic risks from advanced AI, nuclear weapons and biological threats: it researches and recommends grants, runs regranting funds (the private Frontier AI Fund, the Nuclear Weapons Policy Fund, and until 2026 the public Emerging Challenges Fund) and holds convenings. It says it directed over $50 million in 2025, about half through its own funds. Longview Philanthropy USA Inc. (a US 501(c)(3)) and its UK subsidiary Longview Inc Ltd (a not-for-profit company).

spending.source: https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/organizations/932664730 (Longview Philanthropy USA Inc., Form 990 for 2025, audited: programme service expenses $14,454,944 less grants paid $12,599,230) and https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/14444004/filing-history (Longview Inc Ltd, audited financial statements for 2025: charitable activities £13,105,993 less grantmaking £10,262,123, at $1.3175 per pound). Grants passed to grantees are donors' money, the grantees' cost.
